## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (94%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and clean input, but second model disagrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 94%, Invasive 6% | Strongly favors InSitu |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 98th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Top class differs |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu | Mixed neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor nuclei fraction** (regions 6, 7, 11) · context · 94% of nuclei neoplastic, top of reference range [F7] · Measured
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Typical score; concept model weighs it slightly against invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 5, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest invasive-associated score in this case; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · High score; spot check 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test passes; removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: Deletion test not distinguishable from random (0.002, CI −0.005 to 0.007); necrosis and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Second model (MUSK) disagrees; neighbors split: 2 InSitu, 2 Invasive, 1 Benign [F5].
- Regions 6 and 7 show per-region invasive risk up to 54%, despite 6% overall.

## Check on the slide
1. **6, 7** Highest per-region invasive risk; look for stromal invasion versus intact duct outlines.
2. **0** Tumor-infiltrating stroma score peaks here (spot check 19/20); confirm genuine invasion.
3. **5, 10, 11** Necrosis scored highest here but failed spot check (3/20); verify on slide.
